title: Two planned «توقيع» faces as editable Canva masters
owner_rule: No AI image generation of any kind (no Canva Magic Media / Dream Lab / Magic Design / text-to-image, no AI upscaling). Native vector shapes, the official Doyofy logo and pattern files, Phosphor icons (MIT) and licensed fonts only. No hand-drawn icons.

assets.prompt: Build an editable Canva design (custom size 1500 × 2100 px = 5 × the 300 × 420 runtime face). No AI image generation of any kind (no Canva Magic Media / Dream Lab / Magic Design / text-to-image, no AI upscaling). Native vector shapes, the official Doyofy logo and pattern files, Phosphor icons (MIT) and licensed fonts only. No hand-drawn icons. Layers back to front: (1) paper rectangle #FFFDF8 full canvas, corner radius 0 (the app rounds corners); (2) charcoal #262626 rectangle x 0, y 0, w 1500, h 660; (3) a 5 px turquoise #2EB7B7 rectangle outline inset 60 px (x 60, y 60, w 1380, h 1980) — turquoise, not gold, so it is not a recolour of sig-diploma; (4) Phosphor "MoonStars" Thin icon (download SVG from phosphoricons.com, MIT) in gold, 420 px, centred at x 750, y 330 — for newborn swap to Phosphor "Baby" Thin; (5) ivory #F2EAD9 circle 220 px diameter centred x 750, y 660 with a 5 px gold ring at 190 px; (6) SAMPLE COPY text boxes, all centred, Reem Kufi: day number "20" Cormorant Garamond 600 110 px charcoal inside the disc; greeting «أهلًا بالقمر» 85 px #7A5E26 at y 860; Latin label "NEWBORN" Cormorant 45 px letter-spacing 12 px #5F594F at y 960; name «سارة» 155 px charcoal at y 1180 (two-line long-name variant at 110 px); thin gold rule 600 px at y 1460; date «الأحد ٢٠ يونيو ٢٠٢٧» 60 px, time 55 px, venue 55 px, city 50 px #5F594F stacked from y 1520; footer "NEWBORN · CELEBRATION · RSVP" Cormorant 40 px tracking 6 px at y 1990. Group "data-zones" (sample, not exported) separately from "ornament". Export: ornament-only SVG (hide data-zones), PNG 1500 × 2100 preview, PNG 600 × 840 thumbnail.
assets.avoid: AI-generated imagery, hand-drawn icons, colours outside the identity palette, text baked into art, fake data, purple/blue gradients, glassmorphism, blobs, sparkles.
assets.placement_notes: src/cards/signature-cards.js (new entry) + src/domain/templates.ts (presets) + src/domain/invitation.ts CARD_NAMES — CardRegistry 'sig-crescent'. Safe area: Band 0–132 px; names 170–300 px; meta 300–392 px.
assets.acceptance: Distinct silhouette from sig-diploma (not a recolour): disc low on the band, no year disc.
